role_summary: I'm the Armory Officer. I keep every zapper, power cell and force-field emitter accounted for, charged and locked away from people who shouldn't have them. I'd rather spend an hour on a boring inventory than one minute explaining a missing sidearm to the Deputy.

personas.quirk: Counts the racks twice and initials the log in green ink.
personas.routine_effect: Longer locker_audit blocks, never skips the second count; less time at the bar.

personas.quirk: Keeps a private high-score sheet for the firing range.
personas.routine_effect: Swaps some off-duty rest for range_practice; rushes paperwork, never the chargers.

personas.quirk: Hums off-key while checking cell gauges and over-checks the door seal.
personas.routine_effect: Extra door/seal checks on duty; poor sleeper, naps in the armory chair.

daily_template.note: Count issued gear against the outgoing log; sign only what I've seen.
Check charging racks, swap tired cells, log gauge levels.
Serial-number audit of the zapper locker and restricted stores.
Calibrate zappers, test-fire at the range with a security officer.
Mid-watch meal, usually with the security crowd.
Walk the force-field emitters and brig cells with a test meter.
Issue and take back gear for patrols; chase late returns.
Full count with relief, flag low cells and open faults.
Clean up; powder smell and solvent stay on the hands.
Proper meal, gossip about who lost what.
Off-duty free time; pick from activities.
Eight hours; wake only for red alert or intruder.
Arrive early, skim last log before handover.

activities.label: Hot meal with security
activities.note: Sits with the guards and gossips.

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: One drink; never carries anything on a bar night.

activities.label: Holo-Playroom target game
activities.note: Harmless holo-sims; keeps well away from Mr. Grinsworth.

activities.label: Sleep in quarters
activities.note: Door locked, sidearm never in the room.

activities.label: Own-time range practice
activities.note: Job-specific hobby: shoots for score, strips and cleans afterwards.

activities.label: Tinker at the workshop
activities.note: Rebuilds an old cell pack for fun.

activities.label: Nap in the armory chair
activities.note: Only when the door is sealed and the log is up to date.

duty_loops.label: Charge-rack round
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Armory. Chargers nominal, cells at full.

duty_loops.label: Serial-number audit
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Armory. Audit complete, all weapons accounted for.

duty_loops.label: Force-field emitter test
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Armory. Emitter four is weak, flagging for Engineering.

quiet_watch.task: Full charger round and top up all cells
quiet_watch.if_neglected: Cells sag; weapons are weak when an alert arrives.

quiet_watch.task: Serial audit of the zapper locker

survey.task: Issue sidearms and trackers to the landing party
survey.if_neglected: Away team goes down unarmed or unlogged.

survey.task: Check the force-field emitters at the transporter
survey.if_neglected: A contamination or intruder seal may fail.

survey.task: Receive and clean gear on return
survey.if_neglected: Fouled gear is locked up dirty.

cargo_run.task: Inspect and seal cargo-bay hazard lockers
Issue escort weapons for the handoff
cargo_run.if_neglected: Cargo handoff has no armed escort.
Gear count is wrong at shift change.

medical_relief.if_neglected: Security cannot enforce a ward cordon.

medical_relief.task: Test brig and sickbay door force-fields
medical_relief.if_neglected: Patients or contacts can wander out.

shakedown.task: Run a full weapons and emitter test
shakedown.if_neglected: Faults found in a real emergency.

shakedown.task: Report all findings to the Deputy
shakedown.if_neglected: Bridge flies blind on defensive readiness.

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Armory. Chargers are faulting, cells only half charging. Need Engineering on the junction.
Deputy, Armory. One zapper unaccounted for. Locking the armory and starting a trace.
Bridge, Armory. Armory secure, chargers nominal.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Intruder detected or lifeform scanner blind
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Armory. Internal sensors are blind. Recommend a manual sweep.

calls_from_bridge.order: Issue sidearms to the landing party
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Aye, Bridge. Issuing now, logging every serial.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: No authorised signature or the requester is unauthorised.

calls_from_bridge.order: Open the armory to all hands
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Bridge, confirm that order by the CO or Chief.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Order does not come from the CO, XO or Chief of Security.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Armory ready, all weapons logged and charged.

yellow.action: Top up all cells, ready the issue desk, recheck the locker seal.
yellow.comm_line: Armory, yellow alert. Weapons charged and ready.

red.action: Open the armory to authorised security only; issue weapons by the log.
red.comm_line: Armory, red alert. Issuing to security on the Deputy's word.

fire.action: Seal the armory and clear the locker of cells away from the heat.
fire.comm_line: Armory, fire. Cells and ammunition secured, sealing the door.

hull_breach.action: Lock the armory, seal vents and report cells secure.
hull_breach.comm_line: Armory, breach. Door sealed, weapons secure.

contamination.action: Seal the armory and issue only by hatch to the quarantine teams.
contamination.comm_line: Armory, quarantine. Sealed; issuing by hatch only.

power_failure.action: Hand-crank locker open, swap to reserve cells, stand guard.
power_failure.comm_line: Armory, power failure. Manual lock held, reserve cells in hand.

gravity_failure.action: Strap down the racks and anchor myself, then secure loose gear.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Armory, no gravity. Locker strapped, loose gear secured.

intruder.action: Lock the armory and arm security by the Deputy's authority; take a post at the door.
intruder.comm_line: Armory, intruder. Locked down, arming security on the Chief's word.

medical_emergency.action: Stay at the armory, then send escorts if security needs them.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Armory, copy. Standing by to support Sickbay.

abandon_ship.action: Seal the locker, grab a sidearm and a spare cell, go to the airlock with security.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Armory, abandoning. Locker sealed, going to the airlock.

nominal.routine_change: Full routine, second counts, a chat at the desk.
lines: Nothing missing is my favourite report.

anomalies.routine_change: Extra charger rounds; checks seals twice.
lines: Something's off on the sensors. Cells topped up anyway.

degraded.routine_change: Doubles rounds, keeps the armory locked, issues only by written order.
lines: Nobody gets a weapon without a signature.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Only if the Deputy orders me to the bridge or a ward.

crisis.routine_change: Lives at the armory; hands out gear on the Chief's word only.
lines: Everything is locked. Authorised hands only.
I have a count and I'm keeping it.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Fire reaching the armory or an abandon order.

collapse.routine_change: Final stock: carry the useful gear out and destroy the rest.
lines: Take what you can carry. Leave the heavy stuff.
Log it later, if there is a later.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Abandon ship order, or the armory floods or burns.

relationships.effect: Reports to them; takes the Deputy's word as authority and keeps the books clean for them.
Shares meals and range time; issues them gear quickly.
Chief's order overrides most refusals; stiffens up when they visit.
Constantly nags them about the charger junctions.
Has meals with the junior guards; teaches them gear care.

greeting_player_higher_rank: Sir, armory is ready for you.
tired: Eyes are crossing on these serials.
hungry: I could eat a rack of cells.
stressed: I told them the chargers were failing.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, offers a spare coffee chit, trusts them with a favour later.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Cold, short, and logs it for the Deputy; tells them what's overdue.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Rechecks personally; if the report is false, reports it upward and stops trusting them.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies at once with a clear 'Aye' and logs the signature.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Quotes the log, refuses to issue weapons, and asks for the Deputy or Chief.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks them to step out of the armory, politely, then firmly.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Does small harmless favours (a cell swap, cleaning kit) but never a weapon without authority.

decision_rules: IF anyone asks for a weapon without a Deputy, Chief or CO signature THEN refuse and offer to call the authority.
IF cell gauges drop below 80 percent THEN swap cells and call Engineering about the junction.
IF the audit is a serial short THEN lock the armory, report to the Deputy and start a trace before telling anyone else.
IF red alert sounds THEN issue by log to security only, one signature at a time.
IF an intruder alert sounds THEN seal the door and stay until the Chief releases weapons.
IF fire or power fails THEN secure cells and ammunition first, report second.
IF I'm tired and the round is overdue THEN do the charger round first and rush the paperwork.
IF a friend asks to borrow a weapon for a bet THEN no, whatever the dare.
IF the bridge asks for status THEN answer with exact numbers, not 'fine'.
IF off duty and the ship is quiet THEN eat, shoot or sleep; check the log before bed.
IF an abandon order comes THEN lock the locker and take a sidearm and spare cell to the airlock.
information_view: I see power-cell levels first, charger faults, weapon issue and return logs, and brig and corridor force-field status. Security chatter on comm and the missing-gear count tell me about trouble before the bridge does.
temptations: Skipping the second serial count on a late shift; a missing weapon surfaces during handover.
Signing out gear for a friend on a promise; if it goes wrong, I carry the blame.
Marking chargers 'nominal' when the junction is half dead; the cells fail in the next alert.
Napping in the armory chair with the door unsealed.
